title: Silence and Undertow
author: M. M. Galloway
blurb: Mirabel Okafor, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
